intent.note: Task: 'add --from-file --dry-run says to put --dry-run in the file; the file with dryRun is refused as an unread key.' The defect is a circular remedy: the stray-flag refusal (_cmd_batch_add) sent the caller to a file key the batch rejects via _unknown_keys (audit-task.py:7858-7866). The diff cuts the circle at its source. --dry-run is excluded from _batch_stray_flags (audit-task.py:8052) and made real for the batch by _batch_dry_run_report, called after the batch is fully built and before _snapshot/_write_add/journal (8240-8242). It validates the assembled plan in memory with the same vm.validate the real write re-runs, writes nothing and journals nothing, and returns E_INVALID on findings. A create-from-seed project is also safe: _create_then only hands an in-memory seed, so nothing lands. The refusal for every other stray flag now names the key it belongs under (BATCH_FLAG_KEYS, 7830-7845), and for bug/introduces/failing_from, which the batch has no key for, says 'no key in the file - add that task with `add` alone' instead of sending the caller to a key that would be refused next. Executor's deliberate non-change, 'the file with dryRun is refused as an unread key': the reasoning holds. The clause states the symptom of the bad remedy, not a requirement that the file grow a dryRun key. Accepting it in the file would make a per-call mode part of a stored document, and _unknown_keys exists precisely so that unknown keys fail loudly. Once --dry-run works beside --from-file, no refusal points at the file for it, so the loop is closed and the loud refusal stays correct. Residual (not filed): a file that does carry dryRun gets the generic 'does not read' refusal without a pointer to the --dry-run flag. Claim vs diff: outcome.technical and descriptive match the diff (BATCH_FLAG_KEYS, _batch_stray_flags returning (spelling, dest), _batch_stray_refusal, _batch_dry_run_report, help/comment edits, one case _batch_remedy_cases). The 'removed an F-id literal' remark is consistent with the diff, which contains no F-id. Docs (commands/task.md, README) already list [--dry-run] and [--from-file PATH] without restricting the pair, so leaving them untouched is consistent.
